svg.title: Yangle Ma — multimodal learning and reproducible systems
svg.desc: I build and evaluate multimodal learning systems, from text/audio/vision pipelines to controlled fusion experiments. I care about reproducible runs, clear evaluation boundaries and useful upstream fixes. 6 merged upstream pull requests and 2 open. Research studies multimodal fusion on CH-SIMS v2.0. The full text version below includes live links and experiment limits.
